description: This module allows retrieving application preferences from the GConf database, with the help of gconftool-2.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key name for an element in the GConf database.

examples:
- name: Get value for a certain key in the database.
  community.general.gconftool2_info:
    key: /desktop/gnome/background/picture_filename
  register: result

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The value of the property. Returned: success Sample: "Monospace 10"

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: Version of gconftool-2. Returned: always Sample: "3.2.6"
